data.name: Midnight Noodle
data.detailed_description:
Midnight Noodle is a story-driven, choice-based psychological horror-thriller. This game takes you on a journey where you experience the stark contrast between the peaceful night vibes of running a local food stall and sudden, heart-pounding terror.

Synopsis: Ogik's life has never been peaceful. His days are drained by working shifts as a cashier at a roadside convenience store. Instead of finding comfort when returning home, he constantly faces the heavy mental toll of his parents' explosive and frequent arguments.

Until one night, the breaking point is reached. Following a dispute far more violent than usual, Ogik’s house suddenly falls into absolute silence. Darkness. His parents vanish without a trace, leaving behind a massive question mark.

Trying to survive like any ordinary young man, Ogik and his best friend take the initiative to open a small business: a late-night roadside noodle stall (Warung Mie Nyemek). At first, everything goes smoothly, and their stall becomes a popular hangout spot for local crowds. But amidst the hustle of mixing spices, things begin to feel uncanny. From mysterious calls from unknown numbers to a dark figure peering from the pitch-black shadows, Ogik is slowly dragged into a bleak conspiracy he never could have anticipated.

Where did Ogik's parents really go? And what danger is truly lurking behind the thick, chilly night breeze?

[KEY FEATURES]

  • 🍲 Manage a "Mie Nyemek" & Coffee Stall: Cook instant noodles with various favorite local flavors (fried, soto, curry). Chop fresh vegetables, brew warm sachet coffee, and perfect the egg's doneness (half-boiled or well-done) to satisfy your late-night customers.

  • 👻 Psychological Terror & Night Tension: From the cold aisles of your workplace to pitch-black narrow alleys, danger dogs your every step. Prepare for overwhelming panic when the power suddenly cuts out and "something" watches you from the corner of the room.

  • 💻 CCTV Investigation & Hacking: Utilize Ogik's IT skills to hack into the city's security camera network. Scan corrupted, blurry, and choppy video footage to piece together hidden clues left behind in the dead of night.

  • ⌨️ Reflex-Testing QTEs (Quick Time Events): Put your finger reflexes to the test during critical, unexpected moments. A single split-second decision or a well-timed button press will determine whether Ogik survives the looming threat.

  • 🎬 Dialogue Choices & Multiple Endings: Every response in conversations and every decision you make carries real consequences. Piece the mystery together yourself, choose your path, and decide the ultimate fate of Ogik's journey.

data.short_description: Behind the warm aroma of a late-night plate of Mie Nyemek, a dark secret lurks in the shadows. Clock into your convenience store cashier shift, whip up orders at a roadside stall, and help Ogik discover where his parents suddenly vanished after a massive argument. Play for FREE now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 / Intel UHD 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes: This game features psychological horror themes, intense night tension, and realistic depictions of verbal domestic arguments. It does not contain extreme physical violence (gore) or any sexual content.
